diagnosed_failure: loss is concentrated in a small number of bad 192-bar blocks
fresh or renewed LMDE long theses are the target state; stale DTEC persistence is often profitable
confidence, high volatility, blanket faster exit, and blanket below-MA192 filters are poor global separators

LMDE selected memory lag and block diagnostics
LMDE proxy/direct evidence and expected-return estimates
DTEC current state and whether a position is fresh/aligned or stale/persistent
recent realized residuals and forecast errors computed without future bars
transaction cost and declared decision horizon
allowed_interventions: abstention when a validity shell fails

reselecting a winner on the same external validation markets used to report it

source.title: P057 FIAC v0.1 — Firewalled Information Acquisition Controller
source.parents: MIFF → AICC. MIFF removes suspect-source information-flow paths to the protected controller; AICC then ranks only the channels whose source modules remain reachable after the firewall.

source.title: P059 SBTE v0.1 — Safeguard Budget Tipping Explorer
source.parents: CSID → TDSX. At each budget, CSID chooses its economically preferred safeguard portfolio. TDSX finds the nearest budget where the selected portfolio reaches a declared residual-loss target.
